content.value: Ailment strength is measured against an effective threshold based on the target's maximum health, with optional bonuses from [[stat/cranks-dungeons:energy_shield|Energy Shield]], [[stat/cranks-dungeons:dexterity|Dexterity]], boots, and passive modifiers. [[article/ailments#freeze|Freeze]], [[article/ailments#electrocute|Electrocute]], and Flammability show buildup and begin at 100%. Buildup starts decaying after 2 seconds without a contributing hit.
Burn / Flammability

Fire damage adds Flammability based on the resolved Fire hit and target threshold. Without modifiers, Fire hit damage equal to 25% of the target's ailment threshold reaches 100% buildup. At 100%, [[article/ailments#burn|Burn]] begins: base damage per second is 50% of the offensive Fire hit, for 4 seconds, ticking every 0.5 seconds. [[article/ailments#burn|Burn]] Magnitude increases damage, not duration. [[stat/cranks-dungeons:fire_resistance|Fire Resistance]] applies once per tick. Only the strongest [[article/ailments#burn|Burn]] remains; equal damage can refresh it. Combat [[article/ailments#burn|Burn]] spreads to visible enemies within 3 blocks, up to five generations. Water, rain and powder snow halve damage and double expiry speed.
Poison

Physical or Void hits can [[article/ailments#poison|Poison]] with Chance to [[article/ailments#poison|Poison]]; any positive chance guarantees application on critical hits. Each stack deals a base 20% of offensive Physical + Void damage per second for 2 seconds. [[article/ailments#poison|Poison]] Magnitude increases damage, not duration. Each stack keeps its own source and timer. The cap is 20 plus [[article/ailments#poison|Poison]] Maximum Stacks; stronger new stacks can replace the weakest. Uses [[stat/cranks-dungeons:void_resistance|Void Resistance]] and bypasses [[stat/cranks-dungeons:energy_shield|Energy Shield]].
Bleed

Physical hits can [[article/ailments#bleed|Bleed]] with Chance to [[article/ailments#bleed|Bleed]]; any positive chance guarantees application on critical hits. [[article/ailments#bleed|Bleed]] stores 40% of later resolved hit damage and bursts when its 5-second base fuse ends. [[article/ailments#bleed|Bleed]] Magnitude increases the stored fraction, capped at 100%, not the duration. Further applications do not postpone the burst. It bypasses [[stat/cranks-dungeons:energy_shield|Energy Shield]] and cannot store its own damage or ailment ticks.
Freeze

Cold damage adds buildup equal to twice cold damage divided by threshold, multiplied by [[article/ailments#freeze|Freeze]] Buildup. Partial buildup slows movement by that fraction, capped at 90% and scaled by magnitude. At 100% the target is frozen for a base 2 seconds and cannot act.
Shock

Lightning hits can [[article/ailments#shock|Shock]] based on hit damage and the target threshold; critical hits guarantee the chance check. [[article/ailments#shock|Shock]] increases damage taken by 5% to 50%, for a base 10 seconds. Magnitude increases amplification, not duration. Lightning hits on an already Shocked target arc to all visible valid enemies within 10 blocks. Arcs use each target's [[stat/cranks-dungeons:lightning_resistance|Lightning Resistance]], respect allies and pets, and cannot recursively chain.
Electrocute

Lightning builds [[article/ailments#electrocute|Electrocute]] at four times resolved Lightning damage divided by threshold, modified by [[article/ailments#electrocute|Electrocute]] Buildup. At 100%, the target cannot move or act for a base 0.5 seconds. [[article/ailments#freeze|Freeze]] and [[article/ailments#electrocute|Electrocute]] cannot overlap, and share 1 second of control recovery after either ends. Effects and normal timers continue while stunned.

Successful hits against life or [[stat/cranks-dungeons:energy_shield|Energy Shield]] can apply ailments. Avoided or rejected hits cannot. Reduced Ailment Duration on You shortens applications. Damage-over-time uses offensive damage and applies its resistance once, rather than inheriting a hit already reduced by resistance.
Reading nameplate icons

Muted icons with a percentage show buildup. Bright icons show active ailments. Timers show remaining duration; [[article/ailments#poison|Poison]] shows the next stack expiry alongside its stack count. Infinite effects have no timer. Resisted briefly appears when a hit cannot build [[article/ailments#freeze|Freeze]] or [[article/ailments#electrocute|Electrocute]] during the shared recovery window.
Managing ailments

[[stat/cranks-dungeons:fire_resistance|Fire Resistance]] reduces [[article/ailments#burn|Burn]]; water, rain and powder snow halve [[article/ailments#burn|Burn]] damage and double its expiry speed. [[stat/cranks-dungeons:void_resistance|Void Resistance]] reduces [[article/ailments#poison|Poison]] even though it bypasses [[stat/cranks-dungeons:energy_shield|Energy Shield]]. Reduced ailment duration shortens applications; reduced [[article/ailments#bleed|Bleed]] duration limits its damage-storage window. Armour reduces physical hits that can feed [[article/ailments#bleed|Bleed]], while the stored burst itself is not mitigated again.

Cold and [[stat/cranks-dungeons:lightning_resistance|Lightning Resistance]] reduce the hits that build [[article/ailments#freeze|Freeze]] and [[article/ailments#electrocute|Electrocute]]. Reduced [[article/ailments#freeze|Freeze]] and [[article/ailments#shock|Shock]] duration shorten their control effects. The existing resistance potions provide preparation, not blanket immunity. Milk removes active ailments, stored [[article/ailments#bleed|Bleed]] and buildup, together with beneficial status effects. You cannot use milk or other items while stunned, so control defenses should be prepared before the hit.
